description: This file implements the ProgramTable class and its nested Observer class, handling MPEG section processing, particularly for PAT and PMT tables, managing program PIDs, and interfacing with storage and callbacks within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Singleton class managing MPEG program tables, providing instance access and program management functionalities.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Nested class responsible for observing MPEG sections and updating program information accordingly.

methods.name: ProgramTable::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProgramTable.

methods.name: ProgramTable::Observer::Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming MPEG sections, updates program entries, and manages state transitions based on section types.
